artDirection.style: original stylized low-poly assassin inspired by the public visual identity of 刺客伍六七
artDirection.silhouette: tied three-prong black hair tuft, sharp fringe, oversized off-white hoodie with kangaroo pocket and chest marking, black inner tee, charcoal shorts, slim black Beijing cloth shoes, silver scissors with red grips
artDirection.expression: deadpan narrowed eyes, angled brows and closed mouth
artDirection.referenceUse: The existing wuliuqi card, the user's portrait reference, and public character descriptions informed identity, palette and silhouette only. No reference pixels, official meshes, or franchise textures are embedded.
v2Refinements: Replaced incorrect magenta high-top sneakers with low-profile black cloth shoes, layered charcoal soles, stitched seams and flat laces.
Strengthened the tied three-prong hair silhouette, sharp fringe and deadpan eye/brow treatment.
Added hoodie pocket, drawstrings, ribbed collar folds, chest 67 marking, sleeve cuffs and hood seam detail.

referenceResearch.footwearFinding: Public character descriptions consistently identify the everyday outfit footwear as black Beijing cloth shoes, not high-top sneakers.

standardization.verticalGroundCorrection: idle, walk, flinch, dead and reviveRise use Root.position.y only to keep the skinned bounds on the ground; horizontal root displacement remains zero.

skeletonContract.hoodieWeights: Lower hoodie follows Pelvis, mid hoodie blends Pelvis/Spine, upper hoodie blends Spine/Chest.
skeletonContract.deathConstruction: Root rotates backward with articulated hip, spine, head and limb bends; vertex-sampled Root.position.y correction prevents ground penetration. reviveRise reverses every dead track.

castTiming.effect: CutRing pulses and travels along +Z while both scissors flourish
castTiming.sample: At 1.50s CutRing has scale 0.35 and world z approximately 0.655m

attackTiming.bladeMotion: BladeUpperR/BladeLowerR snap closed at each slash peak and reopen during recovery
attackTiming.sample: At 0.58s Slash0 has scale 1.27 and world z approximately 0.955m

validationSummary.headlessPreviewNote: The mobile pass reuses the validated desktop WebGL page at a 390px viewport to avoid creating a second SwiftShader context; layout and canvas metrics are still measured at the narrow viewport. Wall-clock action return can slow under SwiftShader and screenshot load; clip duration, sampled pose, transition and terminal-state checks remain authoritative for this asset report.
